[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] '''Prahmin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Conquest of Makeb]], Prahmin was among the engineers the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] saved from the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Along with fellow [[Beddek]] and [[Cherush]] he was kidnapped by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />
